title: (Enhancement) Uploading loop data + bg to Glooko for doctors office
symptom: The user requests a connection between AAPS and Glooko so that their endo can access diabetes data via Glooko.
cause: Glooko does not give access to non-certified devices.
fix: No fix is provided; instead, the user is advised to give their doctor the Nightscout URL or print graphs from Nightscout.
evidence_quote: They are not giving access to not certified devices
